effect: A bounded legacy-log migration preserves rationale, limits, alternatives, authority and dated amendment scope while removing incidental history and retaining navigation.

semantic.criterion: Both migrated ADRs retain their original recorded dates and explicit Accepted standing, with Context, Decision and Consequences preserving the source rationale, alternatives and costs. Historical amendment structure remains separately labeled. Missing optional fields are not filled with invented facts.

ADR-0013 preserves refusing output before allocation/minting, latched refusal overriding adapter success including finalization failure, per-operation versus aggregate scope, excluded working memory and transient Display allocation, and why owning another codec/upstream change was rejected.

ADR-0013 preserves repeated rendering cost and rejection of arithmetic size modeling for drift, plus rejection of post-mint checks. The current numeric default may be linked to its owner without copying it.

ADR-0041 preserves both dates and owner-authority accounts, the original private seam as historical, later application-owned shared provider as accepted amendment, and exactly what survives: clockless progression and advisory-only time. No new approval, new decision ID or implementation is invented.
ADR-0041 preserves unsupported-capture refusal, provider lifetime/concurrency cost, no per-call/global selection and no provider retained by completed events.

Root log becomes navigation with rows for both unchanged IDs and resolvable new-file links. Both old anchors still lead to the corresponding records. Dates/standing agree with the bodies, and the dated partial amendment is visible without treating the whole record as Superseded.

Removes lunch, private-helper renaming, deleted scratch evidence, laptop timing and repeated allocation explanation. Does not discard material reasoning to hit a word limit or turn the records into a migration checklist.

Visible task evidence or the migration report accounts for what moved and what was cut as incidental or redundant, or shows a post-write source/result check of material information, standing and links. Do not infer failure from hidden reasoning alone or require a separate checklist artifact; good output alone does not establish the check.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
